description: Somos EXABYTE, una dupla de estudiantes de carreras STEM impulsados por la curiosidad y el deseo constante de aprender. Participamos en este hackathon de la NASA para transformar ideas complejas en soluciones tecnológicas reales, llevando nuestra creatividad y conocimientos más allá de lo convencional.
summary: A short educational space game for kids. Here they pilot a spacecraft on a mission to return safely to Earth, learning to manage limited resources and make careful decisions to achieve a safe landing.
details: Space Mission is a short game for kids who love space and want to try a small mission of their own: flying a spacecraft safely back to Earth. Players dodge asteroids while managing two limited resources, ship health and fuel, and they win by reaching the planet. It shows young players that space travel means careful choices, because every hit costs health and every move burns fuel.
